instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Family-owned mixed-crop farm with 120 hectares of irrigated land. We cultivate cereals, vegetables, and olives for domestic wholesale markets. Exploring precision agriculture technologies to optimize water usage and reduce chemical inputs by integrating IoT sensors and predictive analytics into our existing operational framework.
answers.pastInitiatives: A junior engineer built an internal dashboard to visualize our order backlog, which the operations team found useful. However, this was an informal side project with no official support or maintenance plan. When that engineer left, the dashboard became unreliable and was eventually abandoned. This incident highlighted the critical need for structured idea incubation and integration into core operational workflows.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: Innovation is decentralized across business units, each with its own innovation lead and dedicated resources, coordinated by a group-level Chief Innovation Officer. The total innovation workforce is approximately 100 people across the organization. A group innovation fund of €5M annually is allocated competitively—business units pitch for funding against clear innovation KPIs including revenue from new products and process efficiency gains.
answers.additionalContext: High competition demands continuous yield improvements and differentiated organic/sustainable product lines. The low regulatory environment allows for faster testing of novel, high-risk farming methods that could secure future market share.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Hyper-Local Yield Optimization Platform (Agri-Tech)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high competitive pressure and focus on market defense, this radical initiative involves deploying machine learning models across our entire 120-hectare operation to predict optimal planting density, irrigation cycles, and harvest timing. This could radically reduce input costs while maximizing yield per square meter.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated cross-functional pilot team (Agri Ops + IT) for initial data pipeline setup.
Allocate €50k from the innovation fund for a three-month proof-of-concept on one specific crop/zone.
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a verifiable 5% reduction in water usage per unit of output within the pilot zone.
milestones: Q1: Data infrastructure setup complete and baseline metrics established.
Q2: Pilot test results analyzed; go/no-go decision for full scale.

opportunities.title: Automated 'Self-Service' Customer Onboarding Portal
opportunities.rationale: To address customer churn related to poor digital tools, this incremental project focuses on building a robust web platform where enterprise customers can manage subscriptions and view real-time soil health metrics. This improves the customer experience without requiring radical operational changes.

first_actions: Conduct user journey mapping workshops with top 5 churned customers.
Engage a third-party UI/UX firm for wireframing and MVP development.
resources_needed: Internal IT developer time reallocation (estimated equivalent of 6 man-months)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase customer self-service transactions by 25% within the first year.
milestones: Q1: Finalized requirements and prototype approval.
Q3: Beta launch with enterprise segment.

opportunities.title: Vertical Farming Logistics Integration
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging existing infrastructure, this project focuses on optimizing the logistics and supply chain for high-value specialty crops by integrating real-time inventory tracking with market demand signals. This secures margin defense in premium segments.

first_actions: Audit current cold storage/transport routes against predicted seasonal demand spikes.
Develop a centralized inventory management module.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce inventory holding costs by 10% through improved demand forecasting.
milestones: Q2: Inventory module deployed across three key product lines.

next_steps.action: Formalize the innovation funding process and establish clear KPIs for radical projects.
Initiate a quick audit of internal talent capabilities vs. required skills for AI/Agri-Tech integration.
Launch the Proof-of-Concept (PoC) phase for the AI Yield Optimization Platform.

key_weaknesses: Lack of structured process leads to idea failure and loss of institutional knowledge (as seen with the dashboard example).
Informal decision-making slows down scaling and alignment with strategic market defense goals.
Talent gap exists between existing operations staff and the specialized skills required for high-tech precision agriculture initiatives.
Budget constraints limit the ability to invest in necessary long-term digital infrastructure upgrades.
